name: Can I operate my business during water damage restoration?

mainEntity.name: Can I operate my business during water damage restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can operate your business during restoration depends on the extent and location of the water damage. Minor damage in a non-critical area might allow for partial operation. However, extensive damage affecting safety, air quality, or essential utilities often requires temporary closure or relocation. A professional assessment will determine the safest and most practical course of action to ensure minimal disruption while safeguarding employees and customers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Operation depends on the damage's extent and location; extensive damage usually requires temporary closure or relocation for safety.
